about: Stars within 20 pc of the Sun: Galactic x (toward the center), y (toward rotation), z (north) in parsecs, absolute G magnitude, temperature (K) from color, source (0 GCNS, 1 HYG) and name. Made by tools/sp2-stars.mjs.
credits: Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars (Gaia Collaboration, Smart et al. 2021, A&A 649, A6), ESA/Gaia/DPAC, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO, via CDS VizieR J/A+A/649/A6.
HYG database v4.4 (David Nash, astronexus), CC BY-SA 4.0: the brightest stars Gaia lacks, and star names.
Temperatures from colors: E. Mamajek, A Modern Mean Dwarf Stellar Color and Effective Temperature Sequence (Pecaut & Mamajek 2013), version 2022.04.16.
